description: TypeScript file defining conditional payload type aliases based on payload transfer types and interfaces.

methods.name: ConditionalPayloadType
methods.description: Type alias that resolves to different payload interfaces based on whether T extends DecryptedTransferPayload or EncryptedTransferPayload, otherwise DeletedPayloadInterface.

methods.name: ConditionalTransferPayloadType
methods.description: Type alias that resolves to different transfer payloads based on whether P extends DecryptedPayloadInterface or EncryptedPayloadInterface, otherwise DeletedTransferPayload.

ctags.name: ConditionalPayloadType
ctags.pattern: /^export type ConditionalPayloadType<T> = T extends DecryptedTransferPayload<infer C>$/

ctags.name: ConditionalTransferPayloadType
ctags.pattern:
/^export type ConditionalTransferPayloadType

= P extends DecryptedPayloadInterface$/
